[size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Experience Bar ✦[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#67E8F9]Watch every level take shape.[/color][/b]

Follow your skills with smoothly animated experience bars, readable progress details and a style that suits your farm. Choose a clean modern look, compact classic bars or a bright iridium-purple glow—all in one mod.

[size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]✨ Features[/color][/b][/size]

• Smooth XP-bar movement with current level and progress details.
• Five appearance presets, plus Current / Custom for your own settings.
• Rounded, rectangular and segmented bar shapes.
• Compact icon-and-level layouts.
• Optional XP numbers and hover details showing progress and XP remaining.
• Adjustable placement, size and width.
• Separate controls for panel backgrounds, empty-bar backgrounds and borders.
• Show bars only after an XP gain, or hide skills at their maximum level.
• Support for Simple Skills Extended and SpaceCore custom skills.
• Automatic avoidance of recognised HUD panels.
• Optional keyboard and controller toggle bindings, unassigned by default.
• Optional Generic Mod Config Menu and all twelve built-in game languages.

[size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🎨 Choose Your Style[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#67E8F9]Smooth[/color][/b]

Continuous rounded bars with skill names, levels and XP numbers. A clean look with backgrounds and borders turned off.

[b][color=#67E8F9]Rectangle[/color][/b]

Straight rectangular bars with the same smooth progress animation and readable details.

[b][color=#FDE68A]Classic Segmented[/color][/b]

Compact skill icons and level numbers beside gold-outlined bars with ten divisions and dark empty tracks. Full skill names and XP details remain available on hover.

[b][color=#D8B4FE]Iridium Glow[/color][/b]

Rounded bars with bright purple fills and a subtle static glow, alongside skill names, levels and XP numbers.

[b][color=#86EFAC]Minimal[/color][/b]

Small icon-and-level rows with rounded fills, keeping the display compact. Hover over a row for its full details.

[b][color=#67E8F9]Current / Custom[/color][/b]

Keeps your existing appearance. New installations start with rounded bars, XP numbers and no panel backgrounds, empty-bar backgrounds or borders.

Choose Style Preset in Generic Mod Config Menu. Presets keep your saved position, size, key bindings and skill colours. Adjusting an appearance option switches to Custom, so you can refine the look you chose.

[size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]🌱 Skills and Progress[/color][/b][/size]

Tracks Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat using their actual progress.

[b]Simple Skills Extended[/b]

Reads the mod’s extended progress for its Level 30 and Level 100 editions, including banked XP while progression is locked and Fully Mastered status. Simple Skills Extended is optional.

[b]SpaceCore skills[/b]

Reads custom skills using their own XP curves, icons and colours, including compatible skills such as Love of Cooking. SpaceCore is only needed for the custom skills that use it.

SEB displays your progress without granting XP or changing skill rewards, levels or profession choices.

[size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🧩 HUD Placement and Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]

When Avoid Other HUD Panels is enabled, SEB moves around recognised panels, including NPC Map Locations’ visible minimap and Simple Journal Pin’s tracker. It can move rows into additional columns when space is limited.

NPC Map Locations controls its own minimap visibility. SEB reads the visible minimap’s bounds to avoid overlapping it.

Your configured position stays saved while the display adapts. Very small windows or other HUD mods may require a smaller size or a different starting position.

[size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🎛 Settings and Controls[/color][/b][/size]

Generic Mod Config Menu provides the preset selector and options for XP numbers, custom skills, gain-only display, maximum-level hiding, backgrounds, borders, placement and size.

The optional keyboard and controller toggle bindings start unassigned. With a keyboard binding configured, hold Shift and press it while the bars are visible to move them to your cursor.

Without Generic Mod Config Menu, close the game and edit the config.json created after the first launch. StylePreset accepts Custom, Smooth, Rectangle, Classic, Iridium or Minimal.

[size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]📦 Requirements[/color][/b][/size]

• Stardew Valley 1.6 on desktop.
• SMAPI 4.1.0 or newer.
• Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings.
• Optional: Simple Skills Extended or SpaceCore-based skill mods.

[size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]🌱 Installation and Updating[/color][/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download and extract Simple Experience Bar.
3. Place the SimpleExperienceBar folder inside your game’s Mods folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

When updating SEB, close the game and replace the existing SimpleExperienceBar folder. Keep your config.json to retain your settings.

[b]Replacing the original Experience Bars[/b]

Copy your old ExperienceBars/config.json into the new SimpleExperienceBar folder before removing the old ExperienceBars folder. Keep one experience-bar HUD installed to avoid duplicate displays.

This download contains one SimpleExperienceBar mod; no separate ExperienceBars companion is required.

To uninstall, remove the SimpleExperienceBar folder. Your skill progress remains in the game and its skill mods.

[size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🌍 Languages[/color][/b][/size]

Automatically follows your game language: English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian.

[size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]📝 Testing and Feedback[/color][/b][/size]

Desktop checks cover native and custom skill progress, both extended-level editions, minimap avoidance, saved settings and all twelve languages. The five presets have also been rendered with native game fonts. Full live-game compatibility testing remains ongoing.

For an issue report, please include your SMAPI log, selected preset, screenshot and relevant skill or HUD mods.
